title: Empty folder → complete vertical tap-dodge mobile game
prompt: Create a complete Android-first 2D arcade game in this empty folder: the player is a square at the bottom that follows the finger horizontally (touch/drag; arrow keys on desktop); blocks fall from the top faster over time; the score is seconds survived; colliding with a block shows a Game Over overlay with the score and a 'Tap to restart' button. Portrait 720x1280, canvas_items stretch, gl_compatibility renderer. Include tests/smoke_test.gd (SceneTree script) that loads the main scene, runs ~2 s and prints SMOKE_TEST_OK. Everything must pass godot_verify.
